extraction_scope: Worker-6 bounded source-reviewed mechanism ontology from primary XML/PDF, Figure 2/4 captions/prose, methods, and Table 4 biofilm evidence. Claims are bounded to observed assay surfaces and do not infer unmeasured molecular targets.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: ChBac3.4 variants were assayed for E. coli ML-35p outer and inner membrane permeabilization using nitrocefin and ONPG reporter substrates at 2x MIC; the paper supports membrane-damage context but variant-specific curve quantitation remains figure-level.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact curve kinetics were not converted from the figure; final record preserves qualitative/direct assay support only.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RFR-containing ChBac3.4 variants and native ChBac3.4 were tested for biofilm-formation inhibition against A. baumannii 7226/16 and P. aeruginosa MDR 522/17; Table 4 gives MIC-relative thresholds for inhibition and biofilm thickness reduction.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biofilm inhibition is a phenotypic activity endpoint, not a molecular target mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: ChBac3.4-1-COOH cytocidal dynamics on K562 cells were compared with PG-1 and native ChBac3.4 using trypan blue exclusion and Annexin V-Cy3 apoptosis/necrosis staining; source text supports slower action and a higher apoptosis/necrosis ratio than the native peptide at high concentration.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure-level exact apoptosis/necrosis percentages were not digitized; the final claim is qualitative and locator-backed.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper discusses PR-AMP intracellular targets such as DnaK/ribosome from prior literature, but this study does not directly assay those molecular targets for the ChBac3.4 variants; those remain background mechanism context only.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No source-supported direct target-binding claim is promoted for DnaK/ribosome in this paper.
